description.en: The USB Micro-B plug interface: a chamfered shell 6.85 × 1.8 mm, at least 5.4 mm long ahead of an overmold at most 10.6 × 8.5 mm, mating a Micro-B receptacle one way up.
description.es: La interfaz de la clavija USB Micro-B: una carcasa achaflanada de 6.85 × 1.8 mm, de al menos 5.4 mm de largo delante de un sobremoldeo de 10.6 × 8.5 mm como máximo, que acopla con un receptáculo Micro-B en una sola posición.
description.fr: L'interface de la fiche USB Micro-B : un blindage chanfreiné de 6,85 × 1,8 mm, long d'au moins 5,4 mm devant un surmoulage d'au plus 10,6 × 8,5 mm, qui s'accouple à une embase Micro-B dans un seul sens.
description.pt: A interface da ficha USB Micro-B: uma blindagem chanfrada de 6,85 × 1,8 mm, com pelo menos 5,4 mm de comprimento à frente de um sobremoldado de no máximo 10,6 × 8,5 mm, que acopla num receptáculo Micro-B num só sentido.

governing.designation: USB Micro-USB Cables and Connectors Specification, Revision 1.01

sources.title: Universal Serial Bus Micro-USB Cables and Connectors Specification, Revision 1.01 (April 4, 2007)
sources.publisher: USB Implementers Forum (in the USB 2.0 specification package)
sources.supports: Figure 4-10 (Micro-B receptacle interface): opening 6.9 +0.06/−0.02 wide and 1.85 +0.08/−0.02 high, 5.4 ±0.05 wide at the bottom where the chamfers meet, 3.5 ±0.1 deep from the shell front to the back wall; tongue 2.7 +0.05/−0.08 long. Figure 4-7 (Micro-B plug): shell 6.85 +0.02/−0.06 wide and 1.8 +0.02/−0.08 high, 5.3 wide at the bottom; Figure 4-8: 5.4 min from the overmold face to the tip; Figure 4-5: overmold 10.6 max wide, 8.5 max high. §4.2: five contacts. §4.5.6: a wrong-way insertion is blocked

frame_convention: Origin at the centre of the overmold's front face, on the shell axis. +z runs along the shell to its tip at z = 5.4; +x runs along the shell's width; +y = z × x runs along its height, pointing from the chamfered (narrow) side toward the full-width side. The overmold and cable lie at z < 0.

shell_bottom_width.note: where the chamfers meet the narrow side

shell_length_min.note: from the overmold face to the tip

interfaces.note: Male: the shell goes into a Micro-B receptacle, full-width side to full-width side. A mate seats the overmold face on the receptacle's front face, a convention. The x_axis is −x so that a mate (a half-turn about the frame's x, ASM-1 §3.4) puts the plug's +y side on the receptacle's +y side.

review_status.note: Drafted in one pass by an agent (console-hyperobjects standard-parts lane, 2026-11-01); facts read from the cited sources on the access date; no language facet has had a native review.

notes: The Micro-USB specification's licence allows internal reproduction only; the entry states facts and copies no drawing.

solids.note: the shell's bounding box, overmold face to tip, at its minimum length

envelope.note: The shell's bounding box; the chamfers and the overmold are not modelled.
